textIndex.text: John Doe 4711 Any Street Any City , TX 12345 Continuing Health Coverage By now you should have received information from Insperity regarding the temporary continuation of group health plan coverage available to you under COBRA . As that letter explains , coverage options under COBRA are limited to those available to you under your group health plan . By enrolling in COBRA , you lose all employer subsidies and are required to pay 102 % of the group health plan premium . But before you make that decision , you may want to consider other health coverage options that are available , including the following : Options What does this option mean ? Key points Health Insurance Marketplace Visit www . healthcare . gov for more information and enrollment periods . The Marketplace , also known as the " e x c h a n g e " , w a s created by the Affordable Care Act and provides low cost coverage options with potential tax credits or subsidies based on income guidelines . All Marketplace plans offer coverage for

essential health benefits and preventative services . Check Marketplace website for enrollment periods . Individual Health Insurance You may now purchase an individual insurance policy from an insurance carrier without being denied for pre - existing conditions . Consumers may select from hundreds of plan options for coverage that meet their needs . Coverage purchased outside the Marketplace is not eligible for tax credit and / or subsidy . Medicare Visit www . medicare . gov for more information and enrollment periods . Medicare is the federal health insurance program for people who are 65 or older , certain yournger people with disabilities , and people with End - Stage Renal Disease ( p e r m a n e n e t kidney failure requiring dialisys or transplant , sometimes called ESRD ) . Consumers may select basic health coverage and add optional prescription and / or supplemental coverage . Understand what ' s right for you Evaluate your options more fully , based on your unique situation . Call 1 - 8 0 0 - 7 1 3 - 2 8 5 9 to speak with licensed customer service agent about your health coverage . Or visit them online at www . insurance . mercermarket . com
